vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2112 (deferred back-compat removal of the vbrief read path); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Remove the legacy vbrief read path after the back-compat window

narratives.Description: After at least one minor release of signposting, drop the legacy vbrief layout read path so xbrief becomes the sole supported layout. This story is independently buildable as a small resolver change plus tests, deferred behind the locked one-minor back-compat window and conditional on signposting having shipped.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. The layout resolver is packages/core/src/layout/resolve.ts (NOT the previously-cited xbrief-migrate/resolve-layout.ts, which does not exist). Change resolveLifecycleLayout to stop falling back to the legacy vbrief tree (the `return { artifactDir: LEGACY_ARTIFACT_DIR, ... }` branch) and instead hard-stop with a clear error pointing at migrate:xbrief when no xbrief/ layout is present. 2. Remove the legacy-tree deprecation warning path in packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/signpost.ts / renderXbriefMigrationLine (the 'legacy vbrief layout detected' branch) and any doctor/session-ritual wiring that emits it. 3. Update packages/core/src/layout/resolve.test.ts to assert the legacy tree now fails resolution with the migration hint and the xbrief tree resolves cleanly. 4. BLAST RADIUS: resolveLifecycleLayout/resolveLifecycleRoot/resolveLifecycleFolder are consumed by ~50 modules across packages/core; all inherit the removed fallback. Acceptance a3 requires a codebase-wide audit that no source silently reads the legacy layout (grep for LEGACY_ARTIFACT_DIR / vbrief hardcoded paths). Reconcile hardcoded 'vbrief/' display constants (e.g. SUMMARY_HISTORY_REL_PATH in triage/summary/index.ts + triage/welcome/constants.ts, AUDIT_LOG_RELPATH, scope/queue constants) to the layout-neutral form here (#2378 owns the Taskfile + help-string display text, a disjoint file set). 5. Keep deft migrate:xbrief fully functional as the remediation. This MUST ship on the 0.73.0 MINOR bump (locked policy: never a patch).
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the legacy vbrief read path removed after the deprecation window, so that the engine resolves only the xbrief layout and unmigrated projects get a clear migration error.

items.title: Given an unmigrated tree, when the resolver runs, then it hard-stops with a migration hint

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project still on the legacy vbrief layout, when the resolver runs, then it fails and directs the operator to migrate:xbrief.

items.title: Given a migrated tree, when the resolver runs, then it resolves the xbrief layout cleanly

narrative.Acceptance: Given a migrated xbrief layout, when the resolver runs, then it resolves the artifacts without any legacy-path fallback.

items.title: Given the codebase, when scanned, then no source silently reads the legacy layout

narrative.Acceptance: Given the engine source, when scanned, then no remaining module reads the legacy vbrief tree without the migration hard-stop.

x-tracking.deferred: run no earlier than one minor release after consumer signposting ships

verify_commands: pnpm -C packages/core vitest run src/layout/resolve.test.ts src/xbrief-migrate/signpost.test.ts
expected_outputs: legacy vbrief read path removed from resolveLifecycleLayout; resolver hard-stops unmigrated trees with a migrate:xbrief hint; deprecation-warning signpost path removed; ~50 downstream call sites audited (a3)
swarm.notes: NOT parallel-safe: resolveLifecycleLayout is the central layout resolver inherited by ~50 modules. Run as the cohort spine (first / alone within conflict_group xbrief-cleanup), before #2378 and any other layout-touching story. Release-gated to the 0.73.0 minor bump.
